embeds.title: 📊 WoW Market Briefing · Nov 24
embeds.description:
**Verdict**
• Best steady money today is **volume crafting**: Runecloth Reagent Bag (about 2g 93s each, ~58 sell a day) and Dark Iron smelting (about 2g 55s a bar, ~44 a day).
• Best buy: **Felcloth** at 69s (53% of usual price, stock 61%), climbing back from 35s. It also feeds Felcloth Hood and Pants.
• Stay away from **Arcanite Bar** and **Arcane Crystal**: stock is 3-4x usual.
• Buy in the evening and overnight, post late morning to early afternoon (local): floors run about 6-8% higher midday.
embeds.footer: Prices: API scan 21:28 UTC (1:28 PM local) · Cooldown crafts excluded · Writs, Rugged Armor Kit and ladder flips covered separately · Advisory only
